config.label: Bearer token for the iFlow Search API
config.description: Bearer token for the iFlow Search API. Obtain one at https://platform.iflow.cn.

config.label: Optional MCP client slug forwarded to iFlow as the IFlow-MCP-Client header
config.description: Optional MCP client slug forwarded to iFlow as the IFlow-MCP-Client header. Matches /^[a-z0-9._-]{1,64}$/.

config.label: Optional MCP client version forwarded to iFlow as the IFlow-MCP-Client-Version header
config.description: Optional MCP client version forwarded to iFlow as the IFlow-MCP-Client-Version header. Only honored when IFLOW_MCP_CLIENT is also set.

config.label: Optional override for the iFlow Search API base URL
config.description: Optional override for the iFlow Search API base URL. Defaults to https://platform.iflow.cn.
